notes.title: Full Game Release!
notes.notes:
OVERVIEW

Over the course of the last several months, we have been hard at work building and adjusting the game in a way which will make it even more enjoyable and bringing about a fitting 'end' to our short narrative.

What's New?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45143081/a00395f80eb906e5d7a7b2d3040aa010be5a4ad8.png

The final section of our story is now out! This includes new levels and more content for you to play around in our sandbox environments with. This also includes a new spell and some new foes to fight!


QoL Update

Following feedback, we have made adjustments to the game such as including the option to toggle how telekinisis functions within the settings menu. Alongside this, we have tweaked physics (But still keeping the funny 'broken physics' moments) for the better. Moreover, Dropdown menus have been included to replace the 'tick' options for easier readability.

Bug Fixes

Across the entire game, there have been several key areas we have been working on to make sure the experience is smooth. 

What's Next

Following our launch, we aim to support the game by providing fixes to any major bugs or issues people come across (including ourselves). We hope you enjoy the game and look out for announcements on what we will be working on next!

notes.title: Early Access Release
notes.notes:
We are pleased to announce our Early Access release of Robes & Wrinkles!

Having much still planned, we have a host of new content arriving over the coming months...

In respect to this, and for the sake of transparency, an overall release of the game will include 3 main Floors alongside their own unique bosses and the Arcade Mode!

WHAT WE HAVE:  

- A Fully playable initial Floor 
- 3 collectable spells
- A replayable 'Arcade Mode' featuring randomly generated dungeons
- A huge amount of physics based mayhem!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45143081/deea584a7087aa900fc0e2b59743cc4a3dc44cc4.png

SOON TO COME FOR ARCADE: 

- Collectable cosmetics for Skully
- Dungeon modifiers to enhance your chaos
- More enemy types
- A sneaky command line console for additional fun!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45143081/7044b7ccb8ddcab5a4d80a7da797a8d9636e21d4.png
SOON TO COME FOR STORY: 

- New Floors featuring new boss fights
- New spells
- New enemies
- Hidden easter eggs

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45143081/a00395f80eb906e5d7a7b2d3040aa010be5a4ad8.png

THE DISCLAIMER:

As an Early Access game, Robes & Wrinkles will contain some bugs that the team have not yet squashed! Often times, these bugs can be fixed by a simple relaunch of the game but we strive to ensure we pick up on any major issues as soon as they crop up...

On that note, YOU can be of major help to us by ensuring you report any and all bugs to the squashing centre over at our forums!!

We aim to create a fun sandbox experience with as many chaotic moments as possible (Ideally without Completely breaking the game)

notes.title: Major Demo Update!
notes.notes:
Well, I would say that the past couple of months for us at Tombstone Studios have been an absolute blast! Taking part in an incubator program such as Dundev really pushed us to learn and grow. Here's where this update comes in! Lots of features added to the demo to finalise it's release.

Robes & Wrinkles Demo Update Patch Notes:

New:
-	Main Menu is now an interactable environment!
-	Font Alteration in line with a more comic aesthetic
-	Game Intro Comic improved (Done by the lovely Laurance Campbell)
-	Sway added to the player’s camera movements
-	Gargoyles are now possessable!
-	Key room puzzle updated
-	Replaced text boxes with voice over
-	Audio queue for when the player gets hit
-	Spectral Sight now has a coloured vignette
-	Swords can now break objects
-	Death screen animation
-	Audio queues for all enemies
-	Audio queues for all interactions between possessed objects and enemies
Fixed:
-	Telekinesis Book radius increased
-	Tutorial Icons colour changed in line with new intro comic
-	Tutorials now disappear once completed in starting room
-	Controller Main Menu interactions
-	Spike trap to side room now does damage to the player
-	Removed enemy in flame breathe room
-	Gargoyles now awaken as player enters the ambush room
-	Removed invulnerable state of Greg as he attacks
-	Removed “Arena” option from Title Screen
Improved:
-	Colour coordination of Skully and the ability that is currently selected
-	Title Screen Title Animation
-	Title Screen Button Animation
-	Optional Skip with Skully’s introduction monologue
-	Telekinesis Book brought to the front of the room
-	Torch VFX Updated
-	Lightning Flashes altered
-	Door now slams after entering key room
-	Flame Breathe visual overhaul
-	Player death trail now looks like a skull that takes you back to the respawn point
-	Loss of a life now has an animation
-	Player damage indicators improved

Known Bugs:
-	Possessed Gargoyles slide around if player isn’t moving
-	No knockback on gargoyle projectiles
